name: meryem us
evidence: Three WebSearch queries run: (1) 'Meryem Us' + Turkish tutor + Superprof + Canada, (2) 'Meryem Us' + email + Turkish AI/linguistics/Outlier, plus the Outlier AI angle. Superprof listings (superprof.ca Turkish tutors, incl. a Windsor, Canada Turkish tutor named only 'Meryem') never print tutor email addresses - the platform deliberately hides them behind its contact form - and no result tied a surname 'Us' to that listing. Outlier AI is a contractor marketplace and publishes no worker directory; coverage found (restofworld.org on Turkish translators training AI) names no such person. All 'Meryem' hits returned are unrelated namesakes (Meryem Uzerli, Meryem Altun, Meryem Ozyumsak, a Preply tutor 'Meryem C.' based in Turkey) with no Turkish+tutoring+Outlier+Canada anchor, so all were rejected. The CSV addresses meryem@superprof.com.tr and meryem.us@superprof... are pattern guesses, appear on no page, and superprof.com.tr is a marketplace domain rather than an employer mailbox - not recorded. Real affiliation could not be improved on: 'Superprof Turkiye' is a marketplace headline (self-employed tutor), and no real employer was identifiable.
